description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库并在 CPU 计算上把 OpenJev 快照下载到共享 datastore

commands.name: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库到工作目录
commands.description: 在当前工作目录(writable wd)克隆仓库，避免依赖 /home/aiscuser (CPU 节点可能不存在)
commands.command: REPO=./MiniOneRec; rm -rf $REPO && git clone https://github.com/overwindows/MiniOneRec.git $REPO && cd $REPO && git checkout dev && echo 'CLONE_OK pwd='$(pwd)

commands.name: 检查 cosmos 挂载布局与可写性
commands.description: 列出 cosmos datastore 挂载根目录，并探测候选路径是否可写，确认 dest_path 放置位置
commands.command: REPO=./MiniOneRec; cd $REPO && echo '=== mount_dir:' {mount_dir} '===' && echo '--- top-level ---' && ls -la {mount_dir} | head -80 && echo '--- write probe: root ---' && (mkdir -p {mount_dir}/__wtest && touch {mount_dir}/__wtest/f && echo 'WRITE_ROOT_OK' && rm -rf {mount_dir}/__wtest || echo 'WRITE_ROOT_FAIL') && echo '--- write probe: inside an existing Qwen dir ---' && (touch {mount_dir}/Qwen2.5-3B/__wtest 2>/dev/null && echo 'WRITE_IN_QWEN_OK' && rm -f {mount_dir}/Qwen2.5-3B/__wtest || echo 'WRITE_IN_QWEN_FAIL') && echo 'PROBE_DONE'

commands.name: 下载 OpenJev 快照
commands.description: 使用 huggingface_hub snapshot_download 把模型预置到共享 datastore，避免占用 A100 GPU 时长
commands.command: REPO=./MiniOneRec; cd $REPO && echo '--- probing dest parent before download ---' && DEST={mount_dir}/{dest_path} && echo "dest candidate: $DEST" && (mkdir -p $(dirname $DEST) 2>/dev/null && echo 'DEST_PARENT_OK' || echo 'DEST_PARENT_FAIL') && if [ -w $(dirname $DEST) ]; then echo '=== downloading {repo_id} ->' $DEST '===' && python src/download_hf_model.py --repo_id {repo_id} --dest $DEST && du -sh $DEST && ls -la $DEST | head -20 && echo 'DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE'; else echo 'DOWNLOAD_SKIP_NOT_WRITABLE'; fi

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行 ===' && sleep infinity
